http/http1_head#

HTTP/1.1 message heads (RFC 9112): the start line and the fields, read from text and checked.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let head = ParsedHttp1RequestHead("GET /index.html HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: example.com\r\n\r\n").head();
head::Head::method;                  // Method.get
head.target().path();                // "/index.html"
head.host();                         // the Host field as URL parts
let request = head.request(EmptyBody());

Description#

HTTP/1.1 message heads (RFC 9112): the start line and the fields, read from text and checked.

Heads are bounded by Http1Limits: 64 KiB in all, 8 KiB per line, 128 fields and a 1 GiB body by default. This is the wire level under HttpClient and HttpServer; programs rarely need it.
